metadata.purpose: First frozen clean-baseline tranche for resolution-integrity evaluation.

label_policy.clean: Source, timing, and definition are sufficiently explicit for objective adjudication under the published rules.
label_policy.observed_dispute_is_not_gold_truth: An undisputed outcome is supporting evidence only; it does not itself make a contract clean.
label_policy.accepted_cases: Cases were selected because venue pages expose enough rule structure and resolution provenance to support manual clean labeling.

cases.title: Will Bitcoin reach $65,000 before September?
cases.definition: Any final High of a Binance BTCUSDT 1-minute candle reaches at least $65,000 during the stated window.
cases.timing: Aug 6, 2024 14:00 ET through Aug 31, 2024 23:59 ET.
cases.revision_rule: Final candle values control; other exchanges/pairs excluded.

cases.title: Ethereum above $2,600 on July 16?
cases.definition: Final Close of the Binance ETH/USDT 1-minute candle at noon ET is above $2,600.
cases.revision_rule: Source precision controls; other sources/pairs excluded.

cases.title: AP calls 2024 presidential election by Nov. 5?
cases.definition: Associated Press makes its first official declaration of a winner.
cases.revision_rule: A later AP retraction does not undo the qualifying first declaration.

cases.title: June 2026 unemployment rate
cases.definition: Seasonally adjusted U-3 unemployment rate for June 2026, one decimal place.
cases.timing: Relevant BLS release scheduled Jul 2, 2026 at 8:30 AM ET; resolves on first release.
cases.source: BLS Employment Situation Report, U-3 in Table A-15.
cases.revision_rule: Post-release revisions do not count; missing-release fallback explicitly defined.

cases.title: Did US GDP grow more than 2.5% in Q4 2022?
cases.definition: BEA annualized real GDP change from the preceding quarter exceeds 2.5%.
cases.timing: Uses the Q4 2022 Advance Estimate scheduled Jan 26, 2023.
cases.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis GDP Advance Estimate.
cases.revision_rule: Later GDP revisions are excluded.

cases.title: US GDP growth in Q1 2026: 2.0%–2.5%
cases.definition: Seasonally adjusted annualized real GDP Advance Estimate falls in the 2.0%–2.5% bracket.
cases.timing: Advance Estimate scheduled Apr 30, 2026.
cases.revision_rule: If advance estimate is absent, first official estimate is used; fallback horizon explicitly defined.

cases.title: GDP growth in 2025 greater than 2.5%
cases.definition: Full-year U.S. real GDP growth for 2025 as stated in the BEA Q4 Advance Estimate exceeds 2.5%.
cases.timing: Advance Estimate scheduled Jan 29, 2026.
cases.revision_rule: Subsequent revisions are excluded; bracket boundary rule is explicit.

cases.title: Negative GDP growth in Q1 2025?
cases.definition: Seasonally adjusted annualized Q1 2025 GDP Advance Estimate is below zero.
cases.timing: Advance Estimate scheduled Apr 30, 2025.
cases.revision_rule: Only first Advance Estimate counts; later revisions excluded.

cases.title: Annual inflation above 2.5% in August 2024?
cases.definition: BLS 12-month CPI change ending Aug 2024, before seasonal adjustment, is greater than 2.5%.
cases.timing: BLS report scheduled Sep 11, 2024 at 8:30 AM ET.
cases.source: BLS August 2024 Consumer Price Index report.
cases.revision_rule: One-decimal source precision explicitly controls the threshold.

cases.title: September 2025 monthly inflation
cases.definition: One-month seasonally adjusted CPI-U change for September 2025, to one decimal place.
cases.timing: BLS report scheduled Oct 15, 2025 at 8:30 AM ET.
cases.revision_rule: Resolution occurs on publication; source precision defined.

cases.title: August 2025 monthly inflation at least 0.4%
cases.definition: One-month seasonally adjusted CPI-U change for August 2025 meets the specified bracket/threshold.
cases.timing: BLS report scheduled Sep 11, 2025 at 8:30 AM ET.
cases.revision_rule: One-decimal source precision defined.

cases.title: Tour de France 2025: 145+ riders finish?
cases.definition: At least 145 riders are classified as finishers of the 2025 Tour de France.
cases.timing: At conclusion of the 2025 Tour de France.
cases.revision_rule: Official final classification controls.

cases.title: 2026 Tour de France winner nationality: Slovenia
cases.definition: Listed nationality of the declared 2026 Tour de France champion is Slovenia.
cases.timing: Champion must be declared by Jul 26, 2026 11:59 PM ET or market falls to Other.
cases.revision_rule: Tie/multiple-winner and cancellation/postponement handling explicitly defined.

cases.title: Highest temperature in Chicago on Aug. 27, 2026
cases.definition: NOAA hourly-data maximum at Chicago O'Hare falls in 82–83°F range.
cases.timing: All observations on Aug 27, 2026; waits for first data point of following date.
cases.source: NOAA/NWS Chicago O'Hare hourly data; Weather Underground only if NOAA unavailable/missing.
cases.revision_rule: Whole-degree precision; revisions accepted only until first following-day data point.

cases.title: Highest temperature in Dallas on Aug. 25, 2026
cases.definition: Highest NOAA temperature reading at the named Dallas station falls in the listed range.
cases.timing: All observations on Aug 25, 2026; revision window closes after first following-day datapoint.
cases.revision_rule: Whole-degree precision and revision cutoff explicitly defined.

cases.title: Bitcoin above threshold on Aug. 29, 2026
cases.definition: Final Close of the Binance BTC/USDT 1-minute candle at noon ET exceeds the listed threshold.
cases.revision_rule: Other exchanges/pairs excluded; source precision controls.

cases.title: Will the Fed do a rate cut of more than 25bps in 2025?
cases.definition: Federal Reserve cuts rates by more than 25 bps in a single meeting during 2025.
cases.timing: Before Dec 31, 2025; unscheduled meetings included.
cases.revision_rule: Multiple 25 bps cuts do not aggregate; single-meeting criterion explicitly defined.

cases.title: Will rates hit zero in 2025?
cases.definition: Federal Reserve sets target federal funds range to 0.00–0.25% or lower.
cases.timing: Before Dec 31, 2025.
cases.revision_rule: Threshold and target range are explicit.

cases.title: Previous jobs revised higher? April 2026 Employment Situation
cases.definition: Combined first-reported revisions to Feb and Mar 2026 seasonally adjusted nonfarm payrolls exceed -100,000.
cases.timing: First April 2026 Employment Situation release.
cases.source: Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation.
cases.revision_rule: Later revisions, annual benchmarks, corrections and updates are excluded.

cases.title: Core inflation in January 2026 above 2.4%
cases.definition: BLS core CPI (all items less food and energy) 12-month change ending Jan 2026 exceeds 2.4%, using one-decimal value.
cases.timing: January 2026 CPI release; market closed Feb 13, 2026 at 8:25 AM EST.
cases.revision_rule: Source value and precision explicitly identified; shutdown-delay rule exists.
